name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Spider Curl
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 45-degree incline and lie chest-down over the backrest with your feet braced behind you on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip and let your arm hang straight down vertically from your shoulder.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm perpendicular to the floor and your chest planted on the pad.
Lower the weight slowly back to full extension, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Avoid swinging your elbow backward as you initiate the curl.
Keep your wrist straight as the dumbbell approaches your shoulder.
